headline: Inflation in Spain Reaches Highest Level Since February 2023
summary: Spain's annual inflation rate for August accelerated to 4.3% from 3.6% in July, reaching its highest level since the start of 2023.
why: Inflation readings shape European Central Bank policy expectations and Spanish government bond yields, which affect borrowing costs across the Spanish economy.
